serverUrl.title: Platform address
serverUrl.description: The AI Governance Platform's API address, e.g. https://governance.example.com (plain http is accepted for localhost only).

portalUrl.title: Employee portal address
portalUrl.description: Where employees sign in to request a tool. Leave empty if it is the same as the platform address.

enrollmentKey.title: Enrollment key
enrollmentKey.description: The key created on the platform's AI use settings page.
